messages:
Alex: Quick check-in  who's on for the Couch-to-5K kickoff tomorrow morning 7am at Embarcadero? Short run + easy stretch, then back to desks. Good for all levels. :running_man:

Sam: I'm in. 7am works. I'll bring a couple of pace signs (10:00/9:00/marathon-pace jokes).

Jess: Count me! Planning an easy 3 miles, bring a light jacket. :jacket:

Alex: Meetup by the Ferry Building steps (near the big clock). Bring a water bottle, we'll do a 5-min warmup and then loop out to Pier 14 and back.

Sam: Heads-up the route has a short detour if the Sunday market is set up, but still flat and beginner-friendly.

calendar-bot: Event created - "Couch-to-5K Kickoff" tomorrow 07:00-07:30. Attendees: alex, sam, jess. Link: https://calendar.example/evt/1798765432

Jess: Also bringing a tiny first-aid kit and some bananas. If anyone's nervous about pace, we stick together. :banana:

Alex: Perfect. See you at 07:00 sharp. High-fives and post-run coffee optional. :handshake:
